system.description:
Gray ash flats and scorched hills, where little grows. Dust hangs in the air and settles on every surface. People walk long distances and shrug off hardship, because there is nowhere softer to go.

Talent: one Might die to d10, one Wit die to d10.

  • Cinder-Hardened. Gain Physical Resistance +1, stacking with Equipment Resistance.
  • Long Marches. +3 Training in Prowess.
